result.reason: The clause does not cleanly implement the fallback. It states only that the Termination Payment “shall not exceed” prior payments, without specifying the amount actually due, and amounts paid during the preceding three months may not equal three months’ fees. It also applies to every termination by the Company rather than only an early termination and makes the fee the “sole amount payable” in respect of termination, which is broader than making it the sole liquidated amount and could displace unrelated accrued or termination-related payment obligations. Subsection (b) further assumes a determination mechanism that the revised clause no longer provides.
